subject: Error in rbind(deparse.level, ...) :    numbers of columns of arguments do not match

messages.author: 98fb57d9ed19af69
messages.subject: Error in rbind(deparse.level, ...) :    numbers of columns of arguments do not match
parts:
Dear GGIR group,

I hope this message finds you well. I am reaching out due to an issue I have encountered while processing CWA files.

The version I use is 3.0.1. During Part 5, I successfully obtain individual results. However, I am experiencing difficulty in generating the summary results. The problem manifests as follows:


Part 5 Busy processing ... see /data/users/zpc/acc7//output_acc/meta/ms5.out for progress Errors and warnings for 1051831_90001_0_0.cwa.RData$message [1] "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed" $call if (redo1 < 1) redo1 = 1 Errors and warnings for 1088367_90001_0_0.cwa.RData$message [1] "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed" $call if (redo1 < 1) redo1 = 1 ......
......
...... Errors and warnings for 5994165_90001_1_0.cwa.RData$message [1] "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed" $call if (redo1 < 1) redo1 = 1 ________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Report part 5 loading all the milestone data from part 5 this can take a few minutes Error in rbind(deparse.level, ...) : numbers of columns of arguments do not match

And this is my code
GGIR(
  mode=c(5),
  datadir="/data/users/zpc/acc/",
  outputdir="/data/users/zpc/acc7/",
  do.report=c(5),
  idloc = 2,
  #do.parallel = T,
  overwrite = F,
  #maxNcores = 30,
  #=====================
  # Part 2
  #=====================
  strategy = 1,
  hrs.del.start = 1,          hrs.del.end = 1,
  maxdur = 7,                 includedaycrit = 16,
  qwindow=c(0,24),
  mvpathreshold =c(100,125),
  bout.metric = 6,
  excludefirstlast = FALSE,
  includenightcrit = 16,
  do.imp = TRUE ,
  cosinor = F,
  IVIS.activity.metrics = 2,
  IVIS_acc_threshold = log(20 + 1),
  IVIS_per_daypair = F,
  #=====================
  # Part 3 + 4
  #=====================
  def.noc.sleep = 1,
  outliers.only = TRUE,
  criterror = 4,
  do.visual = TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  segmentDAYSPTcrit.part5 = c(0.9,0),
  threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100,125),  threshold.vig = c(400),
  boutcriter = 0.8,      boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(10,20,30), boutdur.lig = c(10,20,30),
  boutdur.mvpa = c(1,3,5,10),
  includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3, frag.metrics="all",
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("WW","MM"),
  visualreport=TRUE)

I would greatly appreciate your guidance in troubleshooting this problem. If additional information is required to facilitate understanding of this issue, please let me know.

Thank you very much for your time and assistance.

Best regards,
Puchen Zhou
